verdict.rationale: Convex's own materials list text search as a built-in platform feature alongside the database ('vector search, text search' in llms.txt; 'Database, functions, workflow, sync, search... zero glue'), and the pricing page includes it on the Free & Starter tiers, so no external search service is needed. The evidence only names the feature, though; vector search is a separate capability and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: dedicated full-text search documentation (search index definition, query API, relevance/ranking behavior, filtering), independent or hands-on corroboration.
